Lantern Tea Shop
================

The handbook of a small tea shop.

## Opening hours ##

The shop opens at nine and closes at six on weekdays.
On Saturdays it opens at ten and closes at four.
On Sundays it is closed.
Public holidays follow the Sunday hours.
Deliveries arrive before opening.
The last order is taken fifteen minutes before closing.

## Brewing

Every pot is brewed to order, never kept warm.

### Green tea

Water at seventy-five degrees; steep for two minutes.

### Oolong

Rinse the leaves once, then steep them in the gaiwan
for forty seconds, adding ten seconds for each
further infusion.

```sh
# not a heading: a comment in a fenced block

brew --tea oolong --seconds 40
```

### Green tea

A second note on green tea: never pour boiling water on it.

Cleaning the
counter
-------

Wipe the counter after every order.
Polish the brass kettle on Fridays.
<!--
